svg.title: Alex’s proposed promotion comparison
svg.desc: A proposed study compares eligible evenings using a one-person standard street-team promotion with eligible evenings continuing ordinary venue activity without an additional street-team push. Both conditions need operating eligibility and consistent records. The business measure is retained contribution after additional deployment expense. Assignment, study duration, budget and analysis criteria still need approval; there are no measured results.

g.text: Agree what to compare before funding the study.
Start with eligible evenings in both conditions.
Check coverage, access, useful timing and specific spending authority before assignment.
Fix the offer, location and deployment window.
Record what the promoter actually delivered
Define ordinary marketing and offers beforehand;
record what actually happened here too.
Measure retained contribution consistently in both conditions.
Compare the conditions after additional deployment expense. Retain cancellations and departures from plan.
Still to approve: assignment, study duration, total budget and analysis criteria.
No trial has been completed. No additional business or winning promotion has been established.
